$comment: Single source of truth for every generated e2a-labs plugin manifest. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/generate-plugin-manifests.mjs`. Never hand-edit a generated manifest — scripts/validate-plugin.mjs regenerates and fails CI on drift. Labs owns no MCP configuration: the core e2a plugin is the sole owner, so this source has no `mcp` block and generates no mcp.json/.mcp.json.
name: e2a-labs

descriptions.$comment: `manifest` serves the Claude manifest and the portable plugin.json; `codex` is the Codex manifest variant. Both marketplace variants describe the package for listing pages.
descriptions.manifest: Experimental autonomous workflows for the e2a agent email gateway. Requires the core e2a plugin for MCP tools and authentication.
descriptions.codex: Experimental autonomous workflows for e2a. Install the core e2a plugin first; it supplies the MCP connection and authentication.
descriptions.marketplaceLong: Experimental Agentify, Autopilot, and Tether workflows for e2a. Requires the core e2a plugin for MCP tools and authentication.
descriptions.marketplaceShort: Experimental Agentify, Autopilot, and Tether workflows for e2a. Install core e2a first for MCP tools and authentication.

codexInterface.longDescription: Experimental Agentify, Autopilot, and Tether workflows. Requires the core e2a plugin, which supplies the hosted MCP connection and authentication.
